Class AccountService

java.lang.Object
app.account.AccountService
@Service public class AccountService extends Object
Service for managing user accounts and their holdings. All operations are scoped to the authenticated user.

  • Method Details

    • getAccountsForUser

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public List<Account> getAccountsForUser(UUID userId)
      Retrieves all accounts belonging to the authenticated user.
      Parameters:
      userId - the authenticated user's UUID from the token's sub claim
      Returns:
      a list of the user's accounts ordered by opened date (newest first)

    • getAccountForUser

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public Account getAccountForUser(Integer accountId, UUID userId)
      Retrieves a specific account if it belongs to the authenticated user.
      Parameters:
      accountId - the account ID
      userId - the authenticated user's UUID
      Returns:
      the account
      Throws:
      AccountNotFoundException - if the account does not exist
      ForbiddenException - if the account is owned by a different user

    • verifyAccountOwnership

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public boolean verifyAccountOwnership(Integer accountId, UUID userId)
      Verifies that an account belongs to the given user.
      Parameters:
      accountId - the account ID
      userId - the user's UUID
      Returns:
      true if the account exists and belongs to this user, false otherwise

    • createAccount

      @Transactional public Account createAccount(UUID userId, String name)
      Creates a new account for the authenticated user.
      Parameters:
      userId - the authenticated user's UUID
      name - the account name
      Returns:
      the newly created account

    • createDefaultAccountForUser

      @Transactional public Account createDefaultAccountForUser(UUID userId)
      Creates a default "Main Account" for a new user. This should be called immediately after user registration.
      Parameters:
      userId - the new user's UUID
      Returns:
      the newly created default account

    • updateAccountName

      @Transactional public Account updateAccountName(Integer accountId, UUID userId, String newName)
      Updates the name of an account.
      Parameters:
      accountId - the account ID
      userId - the authenticated user's UUID
      newName - the new account name
      Returns:
      the updated account
      Throws:
      AccountNotFoundException - if the account does not exist
      ForbiddenException - if the account is owned by a different user

    • getHoldingsForAccount

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public List<HoldingWithCost> getHoldingsForAccount(Integer accountId, UUID userId)
      Retrieves all holdings for a specific account. Verifies the account belongs to the authenticated user.
      Parameters:
      accountId - the account ID
      userId - the authenticated user's UUID
      Returns:
      a list of holdings for this account
      Throws:
      AccountNotFoundException - if the account does not exist
      ForbiddenException - if the account is owned by a different user
